spaces.name: Strata West-Eurasian / South-Asian PCA
spaces.description: PCA fitted on present-day West-Eurasian, South-Asian and Central-Asian individuals from the AADR Human Origins panel; ancient individuals are projected with least-squares projection on their observed SNPs only (equivalent to smartpca lsqproject: YES). Projected coordinates are shrunk towards the origin relative to fitted ones and must not be compared to them as if they were on the same scale.

provenance.projection: least-squares on observed SNPs (smartpca lsqproject: YES)
